title: Nadira
_note: PRO_01 Morning (MAIN_QUEST.md section 2). Lines keep their IDs for voicing. Options show short text; `spoken` is the fuller line he says.

morning.speaker: Nadira
morning.text: He lives. Come eat before the goats do it for you.

choices.spoken: Morning. You've been up for hours.

choices.text: [Dry] Is that bread or a brick?
choices.spoken: Is that bread, or did you build a wall?

bread.speaker: Nadira
bread.text: Brick, wall, whatever it is. Eat it.

chores.speaker: Nadira
chores.text: Water from the well. The goats fed. And the north fence is down again. Something dragged it in the night.

busy.speaker: Nadira
busy.text: The goats won't feed themselves. Well, they would. Everything we own.

report.speaker: Nadira
report.text: All done? And the fence? Good. Now eat, before Tavi gives your bread to the dog.

choices.spoken: Save me the end. The burnt end.

idle.speaker: Nadira
idle.text: Go on. I'll still be here.
